fields.System.Title: Download the error report
fields.System.Description: As an admin, I want to download a CSV of rejected rows with the reason for each, so that I can fix them and import them again.
fields.Microsoft.VSTS.Common.AcceptanceCriteria:
1. The report lists the row number, the column and the reason for each rejected row.
  2. The report can be downloaded from the import summary.
